notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.4.1 — Work Anywhere engines

• Run Factory work on your own Linux server: after checking a server under Factory → Workers, install an isolation engine with one click and choose Run Factory work here. Work Items then run on that server with the same pipeline as on your Mac — the agent through the bridge, and the proof in a fresh environment — and you can switch back to this Mac any time.
• Five isolation engines, picked to fit the server: gVisor (a user-space kernel, for ordinary VPSes without virtualization), Firecracker microVMs and QEMU/KVM virtual machines (servers with KVM), Kata Containers, and rootless podman (only if you allow lower assurance). Installs use pinned releases with their publishers' checksums, through your own sudo.
• Evidence receipts: on any proved Work Item, preview and export a signed receipt of the proof — the exact commits, every check with its log hash, the models used and how it was isolated. Anyone can check it offline with vekrun receipt verify and your public key; nothing about it depends on Vekrun's servers.
• Proof summaries now say what ran the proof — a fresh gVisor sandbox, container, microVM or VM — instead of always "VM".

Fixed
• Commands over SSH could lose their exit status, so a command that succeeded could look like a failure.
